fields.name: replaceControls
fields.description: Show replace controls (default: true). This changes the built-in UI only; it does not authorize or disable `superdoc.ui.search.replace()`.

fields.name: includeTrackedDeletions
fields.description: Include text from pending tracked deletions in each search (default: false).

fields.name: strings
fields.description: String overrides for the built-in Search surface.

fields.name: floating
fields.description: Position and focus settings for the floating Search surface.
